issues.description: Method return type mismatch for the REST endpoint getAllPersons(): In the template repository, de.tum.in.ase.eist.rest.PersonResource.getAllPersons() is declared to return ResponseEntity<List<Person>>. In the solution repository, the same method is declared to return ResponseEntity<Set<Person>>. Additionally, PersonService.getAll() (both in template and solution) returns List<Person>, so the solution's controller implementation (returning ResponseEntity<Set<Person>>) is inconsistent with its own service return type and will cause a compilation/type error when calling ResponseEntity.ok(personService.getAll()). This discrepancy between List and Set for the controller return type will confuse students about the expected API signature and can cause compilation failures in the solution artifact.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return types consistent. Preferred quick fix: change the solution repository's PersonResource.getAllPersons() signature to return ResponseEntity<List<Person>> (and keep returning personService.getAll()). Alternatively, if a Set is desired semantically, change PersonService.getAll() to return Set<Person> and update all usages and tests accordingly. Ensure template, solution, and tests consistently use the same collection type for the 'get all persons' endpoint to avoid compilation errors and student confusion.
